_doc: S67 Boon Draft. After each Ledger the player picks ONE of 3 cards (never two of the same family). Every card = a money trade-off + a lesson of <= 10 words. fx keys are read by Economy.mod(): *Mul keys multiply, the rest add. seasons = the boon expires after N seasons (omit = permanent). lockSeasons = Invest jar is locked while the boon is younger than this. freeEvents = the next N bad events cost nothing. grow = baseMulAll grows by this fraction per season the boon has stood. Designer-editable: keep 3+ cards per family.

boons.name: Careful Saver
boons.lesson: Saving pays you slowly. Spending big costs more.

boons.name: Emergency Pouch
boons.up: The next bad event costs you nothing
boons.lesson: Insurance is never free. You pay a little.

boons.name: Penny Wise
boons.lesson: Cutting costs helps. Cutting too much hurts.

boons.name: Steady Mind
boons.lesson: Calm habits help. Slow sales cost you.

boons.name: Index Fund
boons.down: Invest jar is locked for 2 seasons
boons.lesson: Higher returns need patience. Money is stuck.

boons.name: Snowball
boons.lesson: Growth compounds. Small gains stack up over time.

boons.name: Bold Bet
boons.down: Invest results swing twice as wide
boons.lesson: More reward means more risk. Both go up.

boons.name: Cheap Credit
boons.lesson: Cheap now often means costly later.

boons.name: Payment Plan
boons.lesson: Lower interest costs you in fixed bills.

boons.name: Overdraft Cover
boons.up: The next bad event costs you nothing
boons.lesson: Covering shocks with debt always has a price.

boons.name: Fair Trader
boons.up: Fair sales build trust twice as fast
boons.lesson: Trust is slow to earn and worth a lot.

boons.name: Haggler
boons.lesson: Pushing prices wins today and loses friends.

boons.name: Bulk Buyer
boons.lesson: Discounts today become fixed costs tomorrow.
